3 [10]
Choose the correct answers.
(1) [1]
Black soil retains moisture mainly because it is
  1. clayey
  2. pure sand
  3. solid granite
  4. coarse gravel
(2) [1]
Laterite develops most strongly under
  1. heavy rain and leaching
  2. no rainfall
  3. marine salinity alone
  4. permanent ice
(3) [1]
Chennai receives important rainfall during
  1. retreating/northeast monsoon months
  2. only the hottest pre-monsoon week
  3. no season
  4. the snowfall season
(4) [1]
Contour ploughing helps to
  1. eliminate all rainfall
  2. reduce runoff on slopes
  3. remove soil cover
  4. increase gully erosion
(5) [1]
Used batteries should be sent to
  1. an open playground fire
  2. a riverbank
  3. a food compost heap
  4. authorised separate recovery channels
(6) [1]
The best route for clean segregated vegetable waste is
  1. dumping in a stream
  2. mixing with medical sharps
  3. composting or suitable biogas processing
  4. open burning with batteries
(7) [1]
The main June–September rain-bearing winds are the
  1. polar easterlies
  2. land breeze only
  3. southwest monsoon
  4. western disturbances only
(8) [1]
The newer alluvium is known as
  1. Regur
  2. Khadar
  3. Bhangar
  4. Laterite
(9) [1]
Deep roots in desert plants help them to
  1. avoid minerals
  2. prevent all growth
  3. reach scarce water
  4. increase water loss
(10) [1]
Rainwater recharge pits help to
  1. stop evaporation entirely
  2. increase marine tides
  3. replenish groundwater
  4. create coal deposits

Part II — theory; 50 marks

Answer any 5 questions.

4 [10]
(1) [2]
A hypothetical station in the southeast coast of India has Jan–Dec temperatures (°C) [25, 27, 30, 31, 33, 30, 28, 28, 29, 31, 28, 26] and rainfall (mm) [8, 23, 9, 11, 19, 13, 9, 3, 22, 104, 160, 101]. Calculate annual temperature range and total rainfall. Identify the main wet season and infer whether summer or retreating/northeast monsoon influence is more likely, using both the rainfall pattern and the stated location.
(2) [2]
A hypothetical station in inland India has Jan–Dec temperatures (°C) [16, 18, 21, 32, 34, 31, 29, 29, 30, 22, 19, 17] and rainfall (mm) [22, 19, 17, 0, 12, 185, 198, 121, 202, 2, 14, 17]. Calculate annual temperature range and total rainfall. Identify the main wet season and infer whether summer or retreating/northeast monsoon influence is more likely, using both the rainfall pattern and the stated location.
(3) [3]
Why can northwestern India receive winter rain? State the source, a region affected and one agricultural benefit.
(4) [3]
Explain why a coastal city usually has a smaller annual temperature range than an inland city at a similar latitude.
